# Rohan Mehta — founder & CEO

Founded Northstar Robotics in 2022. Before that, was at a logistics startup that got acquired —
he's cagey about details, something "went sideways" post-acquisition and he left not long after.

Pushed the "boring reliability over flashy demos" philosophy from day one — his exact phrasing (he
says this at basically every all-hands): a robot that fails BORING beats a robot that's 99.99%
flashy and catastrophic once a year.

Firm no on 9-9-6 culture, direct result of burning out at the last company. Also the one who
insisted on async-first stand-ups, with Tuesday being the one live exception (Priya runs that one).

Currently spending most of his time on the Series A fundraise — no firm close date yet, but the plan
is to use Finch Logistics as the proof point ("if the routing engine handles Finch's scale, it'll
handle anyone's scale" is a line he's used in at least two investor calls per Sara).
